title: Quick Coupler System Abnormality
detail_of_failure: The pump controller senses a low pressure in the quick coupler.
machine_effect: If the machine continues to be operated, the hydraulic components can suffer a damage.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If failure code [DHPAMA] or [DHPBMA] is also shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Monitoring code The pump pressure can be monitored. (Code: 01100, 01101)

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. For details, see RELATED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT, CHECKS BEFORE TROU- BLESHOOTING, Electrical equipment. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Disconnect connector P50. Connect the T-adapter to the male side. 3. Start the engine. REMARK Check that the pressure of the F pump and R pump are 3.43 MPa (35 kg/cm2) or above. 4. Measure the continuity. 5. Does the troubleshooting result agree with the standard value? steps.procedure: 1. Do the troubleshooting above again. 2. Can you identify the cause by reconfirmation?

branches.NO: • The pump controller can be defective. • Replace the pump controller. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Connect all the configuration equipment. 3. Turn the starting switch to the ON position to troubleshoot. 4. Check the abnormality record. 5. Is this failure code displayed in the record?

branches.YES: Return to the first inspection item.
